line: From the mountains to the sea as night falls: a stag, a wolf, an eagle, a salmon and a whale, each carrying its own place inside its silhouette, until the whale's harbour lands on the real shore.
line_cn: 天黑下来的这一路，从山到海：鹿、狼、鹰、鲑鱼、鲸，每只动物的剪影里装着它的那片天地；最后鲸身体里的港湾落在真的海岸上。

camera.move: Tracking with the animal, the fill slower than the outline
camera.expresses: the window and the place sliding apart
camera.serves: a journey; a migration; memory against the present

camera.move: Push into the silhouette until its edge leaves the frame
camera.serves: a change of chapter; a hand-over to the next subject

camera.move: Pull back from inside to reveal the outline
camera.serves: a reveal; a change of narrator

camera.expresses: a sudden change of altitude or scene
camera.serves: from ground to sky; a cry, a leap

camera.move: Push and return during a gesture (a wing beat, a turn)
Crossing a surface (waterline, cloud layer) in one move
camera.serves: a breach; a dive; a landing

camera.move: Locked frame, only the inner layer and the light moving

transitions: Allowed transitions: screen-blend double-exposure dissolve, push through the window, pull-out reveal, whip, a continuous camera move across a surface, a silhouette-to-silhouette superimposition.
No wipes, page turns, slides or white flashes.
labels: Very little type. Subtitles are quiet: a serif (e.g. Noto Serif SC 600 for Chinese, Newsreader italic for English; both OFL), Chinese about 36 px over English about 28 px, one line each, on a barely visible soft shadow; no box, no outline.
Subtitles sit in the empty part of the outside world (sky, water, snow), never across the silhouette's fill; move them per cue (bottom left, bottom right) when the animal occupies a corner.

Titles and credits are developed like a print: they appear blurred and sharpen, baked into the image so they take the grade, vignette and grain. A vertical Chinese title works well beside a wide horizon.
Reading time: every cue holds ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); title and credit pass readcheck.mjs.
motion: On ones, smooth, everything a pure function of time.

Animals: breathing, weight shifts between legs, a head lift, wing beats with small tip flex between beats, swimming as in §2. Leaps have a wind-up, a fast exit and a slower landing with splash or settle; nothing rises in a straight line.
Inner photographs move slowly and continuously and never cut on their own.
Lamps light in a direction that follows the body (head to tail, one cabin after another), each with a small swell.

native_moves.name: The window
native_moves.does: A silhouette filled with the place it belongs to, sliding at a different speed from its outline.
native_moves.fits: an emigrant's profile holding a hometown street; a train carrying its destination; a migratory bird carrying its breeding marsh.

native_moves.name: Develop the second exposure
native_moves.does: The shape stands dark first, then on a shutter click the photograph prints into it, rising from the bottom.
native_moves.fits: a memory arriving; a product showing what it is for; a building filling with its history.

native_moves.name: Through the window
native_moves.does: The camera pushes into the shape until the fill is the whole frame, which becomes the next scene.
native_moves.fits: entering a person's memory; going from a map to a city; a chapter hand-over.

native_moves.name: Lamps inside
native_moves.does: Points of warm light come on one by one inside the fill, following the body.
native_moves.fits: a town waking up; members of a network joining; a list counted without numbers.

native_moves.name: Superimpose, don't morph
native_moves.does: One whole silhouette fades in over another at the same place, their fills screen-blended, the motion rhythm handing over continuously.
native_moves.fits: a child becoming an adult; a seed becoming a tree; one company becoming another.

native_moves.name: Cross the surface
native_moves.does: One continuous move through a waterline or a cloud layer, the animal on one trajectory above and below.
native_moves.fits: a launch; a diver surfacing; a plane breaking through cloud.

native_moves.name: Register
native_moves.does: The place inside and the place outside slide into alignment and become one photograph; the outline loosens to a faint veil and a thin warm line.
native_moves.fits: arriving home; a plan becoming a building; a forecast met by the day.

score.note: strings bed, harp and bowed vibraphone for lamps, timpani sparingly
